messages:
maria: Heads-up — after yesterday's RBAC role-rename deploy, our SCIM provision jobs for a handful of Okta tenants are failing with 422 from the provisioning endpoint. SAML logins look good, but SCIM calls return an audit header verification error: `Invalid-Audit-Header: signature mismatch`
jordan: Can you paste the minimal headers + error snippet? sounds like a KMS signer/verifier mismatch after key rotation
maria: Root log snippet:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users 422
headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <token>
  X-Audit-Signature: eyJhbGciOiJQU1M... (truncated)
error: audit header verification failed: verifier: openpgp: bad signature
```
ashley: That X-Audit-Signature is produced by identity-proxy which signs payloads using the KMS alias `projects/rw/keys/provisioner-v2`. Did we rotate that alias yesterday? I see an automated rotation job at 2026-03-19 22:02 UTC in the key-ops runbook
maria: Yes — we rotated due to the vuln triage note about RSASSA-PSS deprecation. Ops rotated the signing to RS256 wrapper. My hypothesis: verifiers still expect PSS signatures
sec-bot: [automated] vuln-triage: CVE-2026-XXXX flagged PSS verifier library. Recommended: rotate signing to RS256. Rotation job executed by @devops-oncall at 2026-03-19 22:02 UTC
devops-oncall: Confirming rotation. We updated KMS policy and the provisioner signer to emit RS256-signed audit headers. I missed redeploying the scim-verifier service that only accepted PSS. Sorry, that was my miss
jordan: OK plan of action — 1) patch verifier to accept both PSS and RS256 (hotfix) 2) reprocess failed SCIM queue once verifier accepts new alg 3) backfill audit logs + mark affected users/orgs. Who can take #1?
ashley: I can push the verifier patch to accept both algs and add a feature flag. Will canary to eu-prod first, then promote. Pushing in ~5m
maria: Support needs to be told. @support-triage can you prepare a short customer note saying provisioning may be delayed for some orgs since 22:02 UTC and we are reprocessing?
support-triage: :thumbsup: Drafting now. I'll post to #support-ops and queue a proactive notification for orgs with >5 pending provisioning operations. ETA 30m
devops-oncall: Which queue do we replay?
jordan: Queue name is `scim-deferred-provision-jobs`. I'll extract IDs and hold until verifier is live, then requeue.
ashley: Canary patch deployed — verifier now accepts RS256 + PSS negotiation and logs alg used. Observability note: added metric `audit_verifier.alg` to track alg distribution
maria: Can we do a smoke test for org-47 (small sandbox) before full replay?
jordan: Manual signed POST using the new key -> 200 OK. Requeued org-47 jobs; they processed successfully and users/groups synced
support-triage: Sent the support note and scheduled the customer mail batch. Link: https://go/reprovision-notify (internal)
ashley: I'll open a follow-up PR to harden CI: add an integration test that simulates KMS alg rotation and fails CI if verifier doesn't accept both. Also adding alert when `audit_header_verification_fail_rate > 0.5%` for >5m
maria: Thanks. Post-mortem actions: add explicit runbook step to coordinate verifier deploy when rotating KMS signing alg, include rollback steps and customer comms checklist, and require pre-rotation canary. Moving to #incidents for follow-up and scheduling a 30-min retro.
jordan: One more note — reprocessed jobs should preserve original audit signature metadata in the backfill. I'll export the raw signed headers and attach to the audit backfill ticket
maria: Great. Closing this thread when support confirms customer notifications sent.
